name: Polished to a mirror, sensitised, exposed and developed over mercury (the daguerreotype process)

roughness.note: The silver is buffed to a mirror before it is sensitised: a first value for a polished metal.

roughnessAcross.source: a buffed face has no grain

textureDepth.source: a mirror under its cover glass
textureDepth.derivation: it holds no film of water

relief.derivation: no relief is drawn over the work's own image

diffuseAlbedo.note: The image's silver-mercury particles scatter white; no measured reflectance of a daguerreotype's highlights was read.

refractiveIndex.note: The particles are metallic, but their field scatters as a rough dielectric does; a first index for its faint specular.

roughness.note: The particles scatter light diffusely: that is what makes the highlights.
